_how: The pop-up's payment buttons come from 'pay' below: fill a field to switch that method on (card = a Stripe Payment Link, https://buy.stripe.com/...), then push. The totals are LIVE from the invoicing app's income ledger, published daily through https://pulse.bigpicsolutions.com/v1/support; the totals here are only the fallback if Pulse can't be reached.
